title: COVID-19 pandemic in Italy
text: The COVID-19 pandemic in Italy was part of the COVID-19 pandemic of coronavirus disease 2019 caused by severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus 2 (SARS-CoV-2). The virus was first confirmed to have spread to Italy on 31 January 2020, when two Chinese tourists in Rome tested positive for the virus.

title: Protests over COVID-19 policies in Italy
text: Between 2020 and 2022 hundreds of people from all over Italy protested against COVID-19 regulations. The protests ended with the abolition of most restrictions in June 2022.

text: Arezzo is a city and comune (municipality) and the capital of the province of the same name in the region of Tuscany in Italy. Arezzo is about 80 kilometres (50 miles) southeast of Florence at an elevation of 296 metres (971 ft) above sea level.

text: Fabio Bartolo Rizzo, known professionally as Marracash (Italian: ), is an Italian rapper. Starting his career in the rap group Dogo Gang, he rose to fame as a solo artist in the 2010s.

title: “Solite pare” by Sick Luke, Tha Supreme and Sfera Ebbasta
text: "Solite pare" is a song by Italian record producer Sick Luke with featured vocals by rappers Tha Supreme and Sfera Ebbasta. It was released on 7 January 2022 by Carosello Records as the second single for Sick Luke's second studio album X2.

title: “La coda del diavolo” by Rkomi and Elodie
text: "La coda del diavolo" is a song by Italian singer-songwriter and rapper Rkomi with featured vocals by Italian singer Elodie. The song was written by Rkomi, Davide Petrella and Dardust.

title: “Brividi” by Mahmood and Blanco
text: "Brividi" is a song written and recorded by Italian singer-songwriters Mahmood and Blanco, released by Island Records and Universal Music on 2 February 2022. It was the winning song of the Italian Sanremo Music Festival 2022 and Italy's entry at that year's Eurovision Song Contest.

title: “Piove” by Lazza and Sfera Ebbasta
text: Jacopo Lazzarini, known professionally as Lazza, is an Italian rapper and record producer.

title: “Shakerando” by 16
text: "Shakerando" is a song by Italian rapper Rhove. It was produced by Voluptyk and released on 15 December 2021 by Universal Music.

title: “La dolce vita” by Fedez, Tananai and Mara Sattei
text: "La dolce vita" is a song by Italian singers Fedez, Tananai and Mara Sattei, released on 3 June 2022 by Sony Music and featured on the digital reissue of Fedez's sixth studio album Disumano. The song was written by Fedez and Tananai with co-writing contribution by Dargen D'Amico, Paolo Antonacci and Davide Simonetta, and produced by the latter.

title: “S!r!” by 29
text: "Siri" is a song by Italian recording artist Thasup with featured vocals by rappers Lazza and Sfera Ebbasta. It was released on 15 July 2022 by Sony Music as the second single for Thasup's second studio album Carattere speciale.

title: “Giovani Wannabe” by Pinguini Tattici Nucleari
text: "Giovani Wannabe" is a song by Italian band Pinguini Tattici Nucleari. It was released by Sony Music on 27 May 2022 as the first single from the band's fifth studio album Fake News.

title: “Ricordi” by Pinguini Tattici Nucleari
text: "Ricordi" is a song by Italian band Pinguini Tattici Nucleari. It was released by Sony Music on 23 September 2022 as the third single from the band's fifth studio album Fake News.

title: “The Loneliest” by 41
text: "The Loneliest" is a song by Italian rock band Måneskin, released on 7 October 2022 as the third single from their third studio album Rush!.

title: “Quevedo: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 52” by Bizarrap and Quevedo
text: "Quevedo: Bzrp Music Sessions, Vol. 52" is a song by Argentine producer Bizarrap and Spanish rapper Quevedo.

title: “Alleluia” by Shiva featuring Sfera Ebbasta
text: "Alleluia" is a song by Italian rapper Shiva featuring Sfera Ebbasta. It was produced by Drillionaire and Daves the Kid, and released on 25 November 2022 by Columbia Records as the fifth single from Shiva's fourth album Milano Demons.

title: “All I Want for Christmas Is You” by Mariah Carey
text: "All I Want for Christmas Is You" is a song by American singer-songwriter Mariah Carey from her fourth studio album and first holiday album, Merry Christmas. She wrote and produced the song with Walter Afanasieff.
